==Overview==
==={{OoT|-}}===
{{Main|Ganon's Castle (Ocarina of Time)}}
[[Ganon's Castle (Ocarina of Time)|Ganon's Castle]] is the location of the final [[Dungeon]], having replaced [[Hyrule Castle]] over the seven years that [[Link]] sleeps after he withdraws the [[Master Sword]]. Its main [[Item]] is the [[Golden Gauntlets]] and its [[Boss]]es are [[Ganondorf]] and later [[Ganon]].
==={{TWW|-}}===
{{Main|Ganon's Castle (The Wind Waker)}}
[[Ganon's Castle (The Wind Waker)|Ganon's Castle]] is the final [[Dungeon]] in {{TWW}}. It is located deep beneath the [[Great Sea]] in the forgotten land of [[Hyrule]]. It features a gauntlet of [[Bosses]], culminating in [[Puppet Ganon]] and [[Ganondorf]].
